reader.zh-Hant: HttpRequestTool 提供安全的外部 HTTP 請求能力，支援 method/url/params/data/json/headers，回傳 status_code、content_type 與 body。
reader.en: HttpRequestTool provides safe outbound HTTP requests with method/url/params/data/json/headers and returns status_code, content_type, and body.
reader.ja: HttpRequestTool は安全な外向き HTTP リクエストを提供し、method/url/params/data/json/headers と status_code/content_type/body を返します。

symbols.name: HttpRequestTool
symbols.summary: Send safe HTTP requests and return structured response payload.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Default seconds cap when timeout_seconds argument omitted (execute clamps to 1..120).

params.name: max_body_chars
params.description: Truncate textual response bodies beyond this length.

tool_contract.name: http_request
tool_contract.description: Send a safe outbound HTTP request and return status_code/content_type/body.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(url: str, method: str = 'GET', params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, data: Any = None, json: Any = None, headers: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, timeout_seconds: Optional[int] = None, save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Performs outbound request under safety constraints; json should be passed as JSON string and is parsed before request.
behavior: Allowed methods include GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS.
data and json are mutually exclusive on the wire.
Returns JSON string of a dict with url, method, status_code, ok, content_type, body, blocked_non_text_body, etc.

examples.title: Safe GET with JSON response body

runtime_notes.content: Blocks localhost/private/reserved IP targets (including DNS-resolved private addresses) to reduce SSRF risk.
Sensitive or hop-by-hop headers such as Host/Cookie/Authorization/Proxy-Authorization are stripped.
Non-text/binary response bodies are not inlined; textual responses are truncated to configured size.
Supports save_policy/output_target/output_path for large response payload routing.
